notes: Site runs on Milestone CMS with images served through a Cloudflare image resizer (assets.milestoneinternet.com/cdn-cgi/image/...). Source originals are very large (4000-7500 px); they were fetched with width=2400 to keep files manageable -- drop the 'width=2400' parameter for the full-size original. The asset server is slow (10-20 s per image). The image named 'a-cornerstone...' on the home page is actually a food photo, so it was skipped. Official site also has a meetings-events/photo-gallery with a dozen meeting-room photos and a lodging gallery. Operated by Aramark as a California State Parks concession; National Historic Landmark with Julia Morgan buildings. Wikimedia Commons also has a Julia Morgan photo set (e.g. Merrill_Hall_Asilomar_edit1.jpg) if more is needed.
